# Kids Flashcards

> > Free printable educational flashcards for children learning vocabulary in 50+ languages including Greek, Hebrew, Arabic, Bulgarian, Armenian, Icelandic, Japanese, Italian, Filipino, and Hungarian.

Kids Flashcards provides downloadable PDF flashcard sets (inspired by Glenn Doman's teaching method) covering essential vocabulary topics like animals, food, verbs, colors & shapes, nature, and everyday objects. Each flashcard collection is designed for children's language acquisition and early education.

## Key Topics

- Printable flashcards
- Language learning for children
- Educational materials (PDF)
- Vocabulary building
- Glenn Doman method (Карточки Домана)
- Multilingual education
- Hebrew (Иврит)
- Japanese (Японский язык)
- Armenian (Армянский язык)
- Bulgarian (Болгарский язык)
- Verbs & action words
- Food & kitchen vocabulary
- Animals & nature
- Colors & shapes
- Solar system & planets

## Language Learning by Topic

- [Greek Colors & Shapes Flashcards](https://kids-flashcards.com/ru/kartochki-na-grecheskom/cveta-i-formy): 75 free flashcards teaching colors and shapes in Greek for children's vocabulary development
- [Hebrew Food Vocabulary Flashcards](https://kids-flashcards.com/ru/kartochki-na-ivrit/eda): 63 flashcards covering food items and fruits in Hebrew for kids
- [Arabic Verbs Flashcards](https://kids-flashcards.com/ru/kartochki-na-arabskom/glagoly): 130 action verb flashcards in Arabic for children's language learning
- [Japanese Animals Flashcards](https://kids-flashcards.com/ru/kartochki-na-yaponskom/zhivotnye): 141 animal vocabulary flashcards in Japanese for children
- [Italian Birds Flashcards](https://kids-flashcards.com/ru/kartochki-na-italyanskom/pticy): 31 flashcards featuring birds and farm animals in Italian for kids
- [Icelandic Verbs Flashcards](https://kids-flashcards.com/ru/kartochki-na-islandskom/glagoly): 20 movement and action verb flashcards in Icelandic for children
